title: Southern Rock
tagline: A rough-hewn sound built from blues, gospel and open roads.
summary: Southern rock keeps the heat of blues, gospel and boogie but gives it a louder, harder edge. It emerged in a region with deep roots in live performance, working-class culture and studio experimentation. The style often leans into big riffs, slide guitar and a sense of movement that feels more like a road than a room.

pillars.name: Lynyrd Skynyrd
pillars.why: Skynyrd made the style legible through unforgettable riffs, harmonies and a strong sense of place.

pillars.name: The Allman Brothers Band
pillars.why: The Allman Brothers turned instrumental chemistry and improvisation into a defining Southern rock identity.

pillars.name: ZZ Top
pillars.why: ZZ Top carried the sound into a bluesier, more streamlined form with swagger and rhythm at the front.
